claims.head: Depth against star power
claims.body: On depth, Utah sits 1st of 32, at the deep end of the scale. New Jersey is 31st, at the top-heavy end.

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, Utah sits 5th of 32, at the bruising end of the scale. New Jersey is 30th, at the finesse end.

notes.text: D. Simashev has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 4% last season.

NJD.head: Leaning New Jersey’s way
NJD.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and New Jersey has home ice. Not by much, though: Utah can make it interesting if it pounces on loose pucks.

UTA.head: A slightly uphill night for Utah
UTA.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and New Jersey has home ice. Utah can tip it if it pounces on loose pucks.
